state.title: State (2-letter)
state.description: State or territory postal abbreviation or full name, e.g. NY or New York. Blank includes every location in the published file.

dateFrom.title: From date (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateFrom.description: Keep only reports on or after this date. Blank means no lower bound.

dateTo.title: To date (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateTo.description: Keep only reports on or before this date. Blank means no upper bound.

naicsPrefix.title: Industry code prefix (NAICS)
naicsPrefix.description: 2–6 digit industry prefix. Broad source ranges match a2-digit sector; uncertain finer matches are excluded and counted in SUMMARY.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Case-insensitive match against employer, city, injury-nature title or body-part title. Narratives and street addresses are excluded.

maxItems.title: Max reports
maxItems.description: Return this many matches, newest incident date first. SUMMARY counts additional matching records omitted by this cap.

timeoutSeconds.title: Run timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Deadline for official source discovery, download and complete scan. Timeout produces UNKNOWN before dataset output.
